title: Yara and the Veil
author: M. M. Thornbury
blurb: Gideon Pemberton, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
